items.title: The navigation trigger is 38px and the drawer ignores device safe areas
items.executionEvidence: The trigger is 44x44px and the 100dvh drawer uses four-edge safe-area padding. Static and browser regressions pass; the byte-identical artifact promoted at exact source 93b867e010dfe3773116433e5b8068dc894e7c0c produced 255 responsive captures, all 240 required states, with zero layout, contrast, touch-target, page-error, or runtime-error findings in promotion workflow 33031371311. The canonical S96 receipt retains 96 hash-bound, ledger-registered images. Manual review of mobile/tablet dark/light open-drawer pixels found complete labels, readable palettes, safe spacing, and no clipping. The pixel loop caught and repaired a cold lazy-island Escape error, then Linux CI exposed a non-portable wall-clock wait; the final harness polls settled rendered geometry.
items.premise: CANON-041 requires at least 44px targets and env(safe-area-inset-*) support. Live CSS sets .mobile-nav-toggle to 38x38px and the 100dvh drawer uses fixed padding with no safe-area variables; repository search finds no safe-area declaration.
items.fix: Raise the trigger to 44px, make drawer/scrim spacing notch-safe, add static and browser assertions, then inspect dark/light desktop, tablet, and mobile captures.

L1.recipe: Raise the trigger to 44px and add safe-area padding.

L2.recipe: Make the trigger and drawer fully 44px/notch-safe, add focused static and browser regressions, and capture tablet/mobile before-after pixels.

L3.recipe: L2 plus dark/light desktop-tablet-mobile rendered-pixel review and a hash-bound visual receipt tied to the release candidate.

items.title: The S96 orientation says the project was active 20,690 days ago and scores five categories as zero
items.executionEvidence: scripts/lib/startup-sil-truth.mjs now validates ISO dates, parses inline SIL v3 categories, and derives achieved-intent streaks from entry bodies; startup authority accepts session-suffixed audits and content-refreshes the Genius cache. Focused negative controls pass and docs/STARTUP_BRIEF.md now reports Active 0d, real category scores, and the live S96 queue.
items.premise: The freshly rendered brief shows Active 20690d, five legacy category rows at 0 beneath an authoritative 993/1000 total, no achieved-intent streak, and an already shipped S95 genius item. Live code admits a numeric silLastSession into a date list, reads match[1] from object entries, requires legacy score tables while S95 uses inline v3 scores, and consumes the genius generator without first refreshing the content-aware cache.
items.fix: Extract testable startup metrics, accept inline v3 SIL categories, filter dates by ISO shape, use entry.body for intent, and refresh stale genius authority before rendering.

L1.recipe: Filter invalid dates and read intent from the parsed entry object.

L2.recipe: Repair date, inline-v3 category, intent, and stale-genius parsing with synthetic negative-control tests.

L3.recipe: L2 plus regenerate and validate the canonical S96 brief, proving real category values, age, intent, and an exhausted S95 cache.

items.title: An exact-artifact mismatch exits 2 without naming the two identities or the differing files
items.executionEvidence: Artifact fingerprints now carry deterministic path/byte/SHA-256 entries. scripts/verify-promotion-bind.mjs reports expected and observed revision/digest identities plus the first ten file deltas, degrades explicitly for legacy manifests, and is wired into deploy-pages.yml. Doctor-driven final integration caught that copying the full 207-file ledger into _health exceeded a downstream launch-evidence read bound, then caught that the verifier still expected full entries from the intentionally compact health document. The final contract keeps compact identity in the 846-byte _health document and the complete ledger in the deploy manifest; positive, legacy, compact-health, and mismatch negative controls pass.
items.premise: deploy-pages.yml line 158 performs the promotion bind inside a one-line Node expression and exits 2 silently. artifact-fingerprint.mjs returns only one aggregate digest and a file count, so the release train cannot identify the first divergent paths even though S95 lost a production cycle to this exact opacity.
items.fix: Emit a deterministic per-file digest ledger, add a reusable promotion-bind verifier that prints both revisions/digests and first path deltas, wire it into the workflow, and prove failure output with negative controls.

L1.recipe: Replace the inline expression with a script that prints expected and observed revision/digest.

L2.recipe: Add per-file artifact entries and a tested verifier that prints both identities plus the first differing paths.

L3.recipe: L2 plus workflow integration, legacy-manifest degradation, and deterministic-build regression coverage.

items.title: Cloudflare now has page loads, but the project has no repeatable evidence command
items.executionEvidence: scripts/verify-cloudflare-web-analytics.mjs resolves credentials through the Studio secrets gateway, performs an account-scoped aggregate-only RUM query, bounds output, and exposes injected-fetch tests for privacy, authorization, and response shape. reports/s96-cloudflare-web-analytics.json records seven page loads (six /, one /landing, zero /game.html) and marks reporting verified while engagement, retention, and cohort claims remain false.
items.premise: A live account-scoped Cloudflare RUM query with the secrets gateway returned six root and one landing page load since 2026-08-23, proving the S94 beacon reports. The narrow zone-settings token correctly failed Analytics authorization; the studio deploy token succeeded. No repository script can reproduce this bounded, non-PII proof, so the Now item would otherwise close on terminal memory.
items.fix: Add a read-only, secrets-gateway-backed analytics verifier with injected-fetch tests, bounded aggregate output, and a structured S96 receipt; mark only reporting as proven and keep retention/cohort claims withheld.

L1.recipe: Record the live aggregate proof and close the beacon-reporting task without inferring engagement.

L2.recipe: Add a reusable read-only Cloudflare RUM verifier with fixture tests and aggregate-only JSON output.

L3.recipe: L2 plus a structured S96 evidence receipt, capability diagnostics, and an Ark recommendation for a least-privilege analytics-read capability.

phantomsRejected.evidence: The existing 641–980px drawer is reachable, inert while closed, dismissible, and visually coherent; only measurable hard-gate details are ranked.
Seven page loads and zero /game.html rows do not identify users, sessions, conversion, or return behavior.
Source-bound deterministic intelligence is already extensive and no cost-neutral demand signal exists.
There are no account flows and the declared identity architecture is external; local auth would create drift.
The first genuine opted-in cohort still does not exist; publishing zeros would weaken the privacy and evidence contract.
The standing decision keeps technical promotion separate from Zoho reply-as, lifecycle authority, external Obelisk posture, and SHA-bound public-launch approval.

recommendedMoves: Close the mobile hard-gate with 44px and safe-area-correct navigation, then inspect the real pixels.
Make the startup brief tell the truth before it chooses work.
Turn release and analytics evidence from opaque or ephemeral terminal output into deterministic, tested receipts.
